mix:6.answer:
According to the DENSO A/C Compressor Installation Guide, to determine the correct compressor oil type, the compressor's identification label must be checked. This label is typically attached to the rear or side of the compressor and also displays the amount of oil inside the new compressor [1, 3].

It is crucial to use only the refrigerator oil approved by either the car or compressor manufacturer and avoid universal or multi-grade oils, as incorrect oils can lead to seizure and damage due to poor lubrication and increased wear [1, 3]. DENSO A/C Compressors are delivered pre-filled with the correct type of compressor oil [1, 3].

* [1] DENSO-AC_brochure_tips-and-tricks_EN.md
